subject: german
topicName: Cases: Nominative, Accusative, Dative and Genitive

questions.question: Q: Fill in the correct article: Ich gebe ___ Mann ___ Buch. Ich fahre ___ Berlin.

points.text: Ich gebe dem Mann das Buch (dem = dative masculine after geben to someone; das = accusative neuter direct object). Ich fahre nach Berlin (nach takes dative, but with place names nach + no article for cities/countries).

questions.question: Q: Which case after these prepositions: mit, für, in (location), in (movement)?

points.text: mit → dative. für → accusative. in (location/Wo?) → dative. in (movement/Wohin?) → accusative.
